import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    names = [t.decode() for t in data[1:1 + 3 * n:3]]
    xs = list(map(int, data[2:2 + 3 * n:3]))
    ys = list(map(int, data[3:3 + 3 * n:3]))
    index = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(names)}
    # Sort by (x, y) and (y, x); on a shared line the nearest city is an adjacent one.
    bx = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: (xs[i], ys[i]))
    by = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: (ys[i], xs[i]))
    px = [0] * n
    py = [0] * n
    for p, i in enumerate(bx):
        px[i] = p
    for p, i in enumerate(by):
        py[i] = p
    m = int(data[1 + 3 * n])
    out = []
    for t in data[2 + 3 * n:2 + 3 * n + m]:
        q = index[t.decode()]
        x, y = xs[q], ys[q]
        best = -1
        bd = 0
        cands = []
        p = px[q]
        if p > 0 and xs[bx[p - 1]] == x:
            cands.append(bx[p - 1])
        if p + 1 < n and xs[bx[p + 1]] == x:
            cands.append(bx[p + 1])
        p = py[q]
        if p > 0 and ys[by[p - 1]] == y:
            cands.append(by[p - 1])
        if p + 1 < n and ys[by[p + 1]] == y:
            cands.append(by[p + 1])
        for j in cands:
            d = abs(xs[j] - x) + abs(ys[j] - y)
            if best < 0 or d < bd or (d == bd and names[j] < names[best]):
                best, bd = j, d
        out.append('NONE' if best < 0 else names[best])
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out) + '\n')


main()
